visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a person's hands scoring a cross on top of a red tomato held over a pink plate. The kitchen setting is bright with natural light from a window. (2) The scene shifts to a red pot on an induction cooktop where the tomato is placed into boiling water, then retrieved with a slotted spoon and submerged in a stainless steel bowl of ice water. (3) Hands peel the blanched tomato, remove the stem with a small knife, and then dice it into large chunks on a yellow cutting board. (4) The focus moves to mincing garlic and then slicing green scallions into fine rings on the same yellow board, showcasing precise knife work. (5) Two eggs are cracked into a glass measuring cup and whisked into a yellow liquid. (6) In the red pot, olive oil is heated, and the minced garlic is sautéed until aromatic, followed by the addition of the tomato chunks which are mashed slightly with a black spatula. (7) Salt, white pepper, soy sauce, and oyster sauce are added to the simmering tomatoes, followed by a squeeze of ketchup and a large amount of hot water from a glass pitcher. (8) After simmering, a cornstarch slurry is stirred in to thicken the soup. (9) The beaten eggs are poured in a thin stream over a chopstick into the simmering liquid to create delicate egg ribbons. (10) Scallions are sprinkled on top, and the soup is ladled into a red bowl. (11) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a pink apron over a white blouse, tastes the soup with a wooden spoon, smiles, and gives a thumbs up to the camera in a modern kitchen studio.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat begin, accompanying the visual of tomato prep. (2) A crisp 'click' of the knife hitting the plate marks a new phase as the tomato is scored. (3) A distinct 'splash' and bubbling water sound occur as the tomato enters the boiling water, followed by the clink of metal against a glass bowl for the ice bath. (4) Rhythmic 'thud-thud' chopping sounds of the knife on a cutting board are prominent as tomatoes and garlic are diced. (5) A 'crack' sound and subsequent metallic whisking noises fill the audio space as eggs are prepared. (6) A sharp 'sizzle' erupts as garlic hits hot oil, accompanied by the scraping of a spatula against the metal pot. (7) A 'glug-glug' pouring sound follows as hot water is added to the pot, creating a steaming ambience. (8) A soft whistling or whooshing SFX transitions the scene into the thickening stage. (9) The music continues with male English vocals as a high-pitched metallic 'clink' sounds when the chopstick is used to pour eggs. (10) A final 'slurp' and satisfied breathing sound mark the tasting phase at the end, concluding with the music fading out.
